Based on my search, I found information about **"Still in Love with You"** by **Brooks & Dunn**.

## Song Details

"Still in Love with You" is a country song by the American duo **Brooks & Dunn**, consisting of **Kix Brooks** and **Ronnie Dunn**. The song was written by **Don Cook**, **Kix Brooks**, and **Ronnie Dunn**, and it appears on their 1993 album **"Hard Workin' Man"**.

## Lyrics Overview

The song tells the story of someone who is leaving a relationship but remains deeply in love. The narrator describes his taxi cab waiting, wishing he could hold his partner one last time. The chorus uses vivid imagery:

> *"If I had a horse, I'd ride off in the sunset*
> *If I had wings, I'd fly off in the sky so blue*
> *If I had the time, I'd spend my whole life dreaming*
> *But I'd wake up, still in love with you"*

The song continues with the narrator heading to Baton Rouge, hoping to be remembered, and wondering if his former lover will still remember him on lonely nights.

## Musical Structure

The song features a key change in the final chorus, moving from G to A, which adds emotional intensity to the closing moments of the track.
